steps.title: Definition
steps.guide: Where the numbers come from, what form the source takes, and who keeps it.

fields.hint: What kind of source it is.
Whether your organisation runs it or someone outside does.

fields.title: Kept by
fields.hint: Who keeps it, if it is kept outside your organisation.

steps.title: Access and quality
steps.guide: How to get access, how often it changes, how records get in, and its known problems.

fields.hint: How to get access, and what you need first.
How often the numbers in it change.
If records start on paper, say how the paper becomes data.
How sensitive the contents are: public, internal, confidential or restricted.
What is already known to be wrong with it.

steps.title: In the warehouse
steps.guide: Where its data sits in the warehouse, as a dbt semantic model, so the KPIs read from it can be built as dbt metrics.

fields.hint: The dbt model it is built on, as ref() names it.
What one row is, such as inspection.
The column that identifies a row. Leave it empty when it has the entity's name.
The column with the date each row is counted at.
The finest it is counted by: day, week, month, quarter or year.
The columns a KPI read from it may be split by, each with the segment it is, when it is one.
